FIRST MACOS BETA · APPLE SILICON

Command your terminals without losing the thread.

Zurafa is a composed macOS terminal workspace for local shells, split panes, file previews, remote SSH, and coding agents — designed to feel quiet even when the work gets loud.

OPEN BY DESIGN

Understand the machinery.

A Rust daemon owns sessions, layout, PTYs, events, and snapshots; the macOS app follows that state and recovers after reconnecting. The event schema and IPC protocol are documented.
